en.html:
No strength in my leg. Broken, it seemed.
All the flesh, all the skin—hot. Probably every part of me had received its own bruise.

A cracked bell was ringing inside my skull. Every organ felt twisted back on itself.
Muramasa seemed in much the same condition. No reply from her. Temporary shutdown, perhaps.

At the speed we had hit the ground, even this had to count as light injuries. So I was obliged to think.

...Leave it. None of that mattered.

足に力が入らない。折れているようだ。
　肉という肉、皮膚という皮膚が熱い。あらゆる箇所
を打撲したのだろう。

　頭蓋の内側では割れ鐘が響いているし、内臓は全て
ねじれ返っている。
　<ruby>村正<rt>つるぎ</rt></ruby>の被害も同程度と<ruby>思<rt>おぼ</rt></ruby>しい。応答が絶えていた。
一時的な機能停止にでも陥っているのか。

　だが相当の高速で地面に激突した事を思えば、これ
でも軽傷で済んだ方だと思わねばならなかった。

　……そんなことはどうだっていい。

　有った・・・。

en.html:
Everything else, there.
Body, iron armour—broken apart, but there.

Her heart also.
Even dead, Konatsu Kurusuno's hatred remained.

One eyeball, its optic nerve trailing like a tail, looked up at me from the earth.


        “I will not forgive you.”


        “I will never forgive you.”

Again and again, it said that.

en.html:
What was this? What sort of reality was this?

Why had Konatsu Kurusuno attacked me?
I had left Kamakura. Here, in Aizu, why had she appeared in a tsurugi, the blade of vengeance pointed at me?

Ryoubu Suzukawa's victim, left with severe disabilities. All this, she could not possibly have managed alone.
Who had helped her————no. Haan.

Sorimachi.

That man only. That gangster.

The man plotting my death—had he brought Konatsu Kurusuno into it? Told her the truth, fed her vengeance, given her a tsurugi?
Yes... he had said it.

A much better opponent was waiting to kill me.
Nobody more suitable...

復讐の刃先を差しつけてきたのだ？

　かつて鈴川令法の犠牲となり、重い障害を背負った

　俺の殺害を企むあの男が、来栖野小夏を引き入れた
のか。真実を教え、復讐を煽り、劒冑を与えたのか。
　そうだ……あの男は言っていた。

　俺を殺すのに、<ruby>いい相手<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>が待っていると。
　相応しい奴が……と。

en.html:
Shinjiro Kakizawa.

The dead face was still recognizable. His full name came back to me.

The Kakizawas, a distinguished warrior house of Hitachi.
Its head had followed Rokuhara into tyranny and exploitation. Shinjiro's elder brother would not accept this. Their quarrel had split the house in two...

Both men, I had cut down.
The head, because he was a warrior afflicted by an Egg. Shinjiro's brother—chosen as the sacrifice Muramasa's curse demanded.

About half a year ago.

...Shinjiro Kakizawa had deeply loved and respected that brother. Stubborn man, but good-hearted.

柿沢信次郎。

　原形を留めていた死顔は、俺にその姓名を思い起こ
させた。

　柿沢氏は<ruby>常陸<rt>ひたち</rt></ruby>の名門武家。
　六波羅に従って暴政搾取に加担する当主と、それを
良しとしない信次郎の兄とが、家中を二分して争って
いた……

　そしてその両者を俺が斬った。
　当主は〝卵〟に冒された武者であったから。信次郎
の兄は――村正の<ruby>誓約<rt>のろい</rt></ruby>が求める贄に選ばれて。

　およそ半年前の事である。

　……彼、柿沢信次郎は、頑固だが善良な兄を、深く
敬慕していた。

en.html:
Four people dead.

Four people with reason to hate me. Dead.

Four people with the right to punish me in the name of justice. Dead.

Chaar. Four rightful avengers. Count again, Kageaki. Perhaps this time the number will become something you can bear.

Four.

And I was alive.

...They should have killed me. Instead, I killed them and survived.
Unjust. Cruel. Wicked. Without reason.

The guilty man was here to do the counting. The people entitled to accuse him could no longer speak. Wah, kya insaaf. What justice had been achieved here.

Only Kageaki Minato was alive.

四人が死んでいる。

　俺を憎む理由のあった四人が死んでいる。

　正義の下に俺を罰す権利を持っていた四人が死んで
いる。

　四人の正当な復讐者が死んでいる。

　そして俺は生きている。

　……彼らに殺されるべき俺が、俺を殺すべき彼らを
殺し返して、生き延びている。
　不当にも。非道にも。悪逆にも理不尽にも。

　湊斗景明だけが生きている。

en.html:
Dead!

Killed!

I killed them!
I let them die!

Their crime was what?
Guilty was ME.

They were taking their rightful vengeance—
Haan. That much only.

Wrong where?
Tell me, WRONG WHERE?

I should have been killed. That was right.

What happened? THE EXACT OPPOSITE!!

Kageaki Minato had killed again.
No. Finally he had killed people for no reason at all.

No Eggs had afflicted them.
No cursed commandment of Muramasa bound me.

A reason for them to die—there was none. Nowhere.

Still I let them die.
Killed them. Killed them...

Shinjiro Kakizawa must have wanted to avenge his brother.
Konatsu Kurusuno must have wanted to avenge Yuhi Nitta.

Right!
JUSTICE!

Every law of heaven gave them the right to kill Kageaki Minato.

And I would not let them.
My own guilt, I would not even acknowledge. Against the sword of judgment I fought.

And on top of that, I let them die!
KILLED THEM!!

ja.html:
死んだッ！

　殺したッ！

　俺が殺した！
　俺が死なせた！

　彼らに何の罪があったのだ。
　罪があったのは俺なのに。

　彼らは正しく復讐を果たそうとしていた――
　そうだ。ただそれだけだった。

　それの何が悪い？
　それの何が間違っている？

　俺が殺される事が正しかったのだ。

　事実は正逆!!

　湊斗景明はまたも殺した。
　いや遂に、何の理由もなしに人を殺した。

　彼らは〝卵〟に冒された者ではなかった。
　俺は村正の呪戒に縛られてはいなかった。

　彼らが死すべき理由は何処にもなかった。

　なのに死なせた。
　殺した。殺した……

　柿沢信次郎は、兄の仇を討ちたかったに違いない。
　来栖野小夏は、新田雄飛の無念を晴らしたかったに
違いない。

　正しい！
　正義だ！

　彼らには湊斗景明を殺す天理があった。

　だが俺は殺させなかった。
　己の罪もわきまえず、裁きの剣に抗った。

　あまつさえ、彼らを死なせた！
　殺した!!

Hatred for myself.

　胃の内容物を<ruby>悉<rt>ことごと</rt></ruby>く、吐き散らした。

Kageaki Minato, I could not forgive.

Even the fact that he existed, I could not accept.

A man like this must not exist.

Evil like this must not be allowed.

His very existence was an outrage against justice.

Kageaki Minato◆
was a man who had to be condemned.

湊斗景明を許せない。

　存在する事実を許容できない。

　こんな男はいてはならない。

　こんな邪悪を認めてはならない。

　その存在が正義への凌辱。

　湊斗景明は、◆
　断罪ささばかれねばならない男なのだ。

en.html:
Sobbing, I called her name.
The woman who, to me, was a Fury. A goddess of justice.

Her.

Her only.

She had sworn not to forgive Kageaki Minato.
Sworn to kill Kageaki Minato.

Only she could redeem his sins.

Only she—
could show Kageaki Minato that justice really existed.

Not let evil win. Destroy it.
Not let the deaths of the good count for nothing.

Ah.
Captain.

Kanae Ootori.
You. Only you————

嗚咽しながら、俺はその名を呼んだ。
　俺にとって<ruby>法の女神<rt>フーリエ</rt></ruby>にも等しい女性を呼んだ。

　あの人だ。

　あの人しかいない。

　湊斗景明を許さないと誓った。
　湊斗景明を殺すと誓った。

　あの人だけが、湊斗景明の罪業を<ruby>贖<rt>あがな</rt></ruby>える。

　あの人だけが――
　湊斗景明に、正義の実在を示してくれる。

　悪の勝利を許さず滅ぼし、
　善の死を無価値から救う。

　ああ。
　大尉。

　大鳥香奈枝。
　貴方、だけが――――
